title: Drivers and riverine fluxes of rare earth elements to coastal ecosystems across temperate, boreal, and subarctic ecoregions in Eastern Canada
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2025, 27,2740-2754
DOI: 10.1039/D5EM00391A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Marie-Christine Lafrenière, Md Samrat Alam, Jean-François Lapierre, Dominic E. Ponton, Maxime Wauthy, Caroline Fink-Mercier, Holly Marginson, Paul del Giorgio, Marc Amyot
REE fluxes from rivers into the Hudson Bay and Atlantic Ocean in Quebec reveal regional contrasts, with fluxes to the Atlantic 2.7 times higher, partly due to erosion. REE levels were influenced by dissolved organic carbon, iron, pH and temperature.
